up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the ChEMBL database that meet the following criteria: (1) The activity must be of type 'IC50' and have a defined pChEMBL value (pchembl_value IS NOT NULL). (2) The assay associated with the activity must be for the target with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL283' (Stromelysin-1). (3) The target must be a single protein (target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN') and from the organism Homo sapiens (tax_id = 9606). Return the following columns: the ChEMBL ID of the assay (assays.chembl_id), the target type, the target tax_id, the canonical SMILES of the molecule, the ChEMBL ID of the molecule, the standard type of the activity, and the pChEMBL value. Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID and then by the assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL283'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id ASC,
  ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
